items.title: Enhancing Metacognitive AI: Knowledge-Graph Population with Graph-Theoretic LLM Enrichment
items.title_zh: 增强元认知 AI：用图论 LLM 增强进行知识图谱填充
items.summary: MetaKGEnrich builds a knowledge graph from a seed query, detects sparse regions using seven graph metrics and has GPT-4o generate targeted questions whose web-retrieved answers are ingested into Neo4j. On 30 queries from each of three datasets it improved GraphRAG answer quality for 80% of HotpotQA, 87% of Natural Questions and 83% of MS MARCO questions.

items.title: GraphMind: From Operational Traces to Self-Evolving Workflow Automation
items.title_zh: GraphMind：从运维轨迹到自进化工作流自动化
items.summary: GraphMind extracts action-centric workflow graphs from human resolution traces, executes them with a multi-agent traversal engine, and reinforces successful paths through Adaptive Traversal Reinforcement. Deployed across four production cloud database services, it required 8x less retrieval context than an Agentic Summary-RAG baseline, and its Adaptive Traversal Reinforcement layer reduced hallucination rate by 26%.

items.title: Thinking Ahead: Prospection-Guided Retrieval of Memory with Language Models
items.title_zh: 提前思考：语言模型中以展望引导的记忆检索
items.summary: Prospection-Guided Retrieval expands a user query into a Tree-of-Thought or linear chain of plausible next steps and uses those steps as retrieval probes rather than relying on the original query alone. On the new MemoryQuest benchmark it reports nearly 3x recall over the strongest baseline, and its responses were preferred in 89-98% of pairwise LLM-as-judge comparisons.

items.title: RAGA: Reading-And-Graph-building-Agent for Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: RAGA：用于自主知识图谱构建与检索增强生成的读写建图智能体
items.summary: RAGA is an LLM-based autonomous knowledge graph construction and retrieval framework that exposes atomic CRUD tools and embeds a Read-Search-Verify-Construct constraint into a ReAct loop. A KG-vector synchronization mechanism enables hybrid symbolic-vector retrieval, and evidence-anchored verification links every entry to its source text; preliminary QASPER experiments show gains over zero-shot baselines.

items.title: Comment and Control: Hijacking Agentic Workflows via Context-Grounded Evolution
items.title_zh: 评论与控制：借助上下文锚定演化劫持智能体工作流
items.summary: JAW is a detection and exploitation framework that hijacks agentic workflows on automation platforms by evolving crafted inputs under contexts derived from static path-feasibility, dynamic prompt-provenance and capability analysis. The authors report 4,714 GitHub workflows and eight n8n templates could be hijacked, and the findings span 15 widely used GitHub Actions, including official actions for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen CLI and Cursor CLI.

items.title: Adversarial SQL Injection Generation with LLM-Based Architectures
items.title_zh: 基于 LLM 架构的对抗性 SQL 注入生成
items.summary: The paper introduces RADAGAS, a retrieval-augmented generation system for adversarial SQL injection generation, and RefleXQLi, a reflective chain-of-thought variant, comparing them against ten web application firewalls. RADAGAS-GPT4o achieved a 22.73% bypass rate overall, while the variants were far more successful on AI/ML-based firewalls than on rule-based ones.

items.title: Internalizing Curriculum Judgment for LLM Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: METIS：为 LLM 强化微调内化课程判断
items.summary: METIS internalizes curriculum judgment in LLM reinforcement fine-tuning by predicting within-prompt reward variance from recent training outcomes and jointly optimizing that self-judgment with standard RFT rewards. The authors report up to 2.1x training speedup across mathematical reasoning, code generation and agentic function-calling benchmarks.

items.title: Dynamic Skill Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: SLIM：面向智能体强化学习的动态技能生命周期管理
items.summary: SLIM treats an agent's active external skill set as a dynamic optimization variable jointly updated with policy learning, using leave-one-skill-out validation to retain, retire or expand skills. It beats the best baselines by an average of 7.1 points across ALFWorld and SearchQA.

items.title: Soohak: A Mathematician-Curated Benchmark for Evaluating Research-level Math Capabilities of LLMs
items.title_zh: Soohak：由数学家策划的研究级数学能力评测基准
items.summary: EleutherAI introduced Soohak, a 439-problem benchmark written from scratch by 64 mathematicians to test research-level math capabilities. On its Challenge subset Gemini-3-Pro reaches 30.4%, GPT-5 26.4% and Claude-Opus-4.5 10.4%, and no model clears 50% at identifying ill-posed problems.

items.title: Mini-JEPA Foundation Model Fleet Enables Agentic Hydrologic Intelligence
items.title_zh: Mini-JEPA 基础模型集群赋能智能体水文智能
items.summary: The paper pretrains five 22M-parameter sensor-specialized JEPA models on Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, MODIS and other geospatial inputs, with a router LLM selecting modalities for specialized hydrologic questions. Dual retrieval over AlphaEarth and the routed fleet outperformed AlphaEarth alone on physics-matched questions in a paired LLM-as-judge evaluation.

items.title: From Feedback Loops to Policy Updates: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Alpha Factor Discovery
items.title_zh: 从反馈循环到策略更新：面向 LLM Alpha 因子发现的强化微调
items.summary: QuantEvolver replaces prompt-level generation-evaluation-feedback loops with reinforcement fine-tuning, converting executable quantitative evaluation into policy updates so a Miner LLM internalizes historical optimization experience. It accumulates high-quality factors in a mined factor database and improves the primary metric over LLM-based alpha-factor baselines on three market benchmarks.

items.title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image
items.title_zh: MulTaBench：以文本与图像评测多模态表格学习
items.summary: MulTaBench is a 40-dataset benchmark split evenly between image-tabular and text-tabular tasks, introduced by Technion researchers. It shows that tuning embeddings to the target task beats frozen pretrained embeddings.

items.title: FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast
items.title_zh: FORGE：无需权重更新、通过种群广播自进化的智能体记忆
items.summary: FORGE is a staged, population-based protocol that evolves prompt-injected natural-language memory for hierarchical ReAct agents without gradient updates, converting failed trajectories into reusable rules, examples or both. On the stochastic CybORG CAGE-2 network-defense task it improved average return by 1.7-7.7x over zero-shot and by 29-72% over Reflexion across all 12 model-representation conditions.

items.title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
items.title_zh: RewardHarness：自进化的智能体式后训练
items.summary: RewardHarness is a framework from the Natural and Artificial Intelligence Lab that reframes image-edit reward modeling as evolving a library of tools and skills from about 100 demonstrations. It reports 47.4% average accuracy, beating GPT-5 by 5.3 points on image-editing evaluation benchmarks.

items.title: Evaluating Deep Research Agents on Expert Consulting Work: A Benchmark with Verifiers, Rubrics, and Cognitive Traps
items.title_zh: 评估深度研究智能体在专家咨询工作中的表现：带验证器、评分标准与认知陷阱的基准
items.summary: The benchmark comprises 70 SME-authored management consulting prompts with embedded cognitive traps, scored by deterministic binary verifiers and a five-criterion rubric. o3-deep-research led the continuous Verifier-Rubric Score at 61.4, but no agent exceeded a 15.7% acceptance rate under the joint threshold.

items.title: Validate Your Authority: Benchmarking LLMs on Multi-Label Precedent Treatment Classification
items.title_zh: 验证你的权威：多标签判例处理分类的 LLM 基准评测
items.summary: The paper introduces an expert-annotated dataset of 239 real-world legal citations and an Average Severity Error metric for multi-label precedent treatment classification. Gemini 2.5 Flash reached 79.1% on the high-level task, while GPT-5-mini led the more complex fine-grained schema at 67.7%.

items.title: From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 从存储到经验：LLM 智能体记忆机制演化综述
items.summary: This survey proposes an evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory with three stages: storage for trajectory preservation, reflection for trajectory refinement and experience for trajectory abstraction. Its companion GitHub repository had 58 stars.

items.title: Automated Big Data Quality Assessment using Knowledge Graph Embeddings
items.title_zh: 利用知识图谱嵌入进行自动化大数据质量评估
items.summary: The paper uses knowledge graph embeddings to predict missing edges between a dataset's context representation and relevant quality rules and dimensions, producing a context-specific data quality assessment plan. It evaluates the approach with AmpliGraph on a real-world radiation sensor dataset from the Lebanese Atomic Energy Commission.

items.title: Derivation Prompting: A Logic-Based Method for Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: 推导式提示：改进检索增强生成的逻辑方法
items.summary: Derivation Prompting is a generation-step technique for retrieval-augmented generation that derives conclusions from initial hypotheses through systematic application of predefined rules, building an interpretable derivation tree. In a case study it significantly reduced unacceptable answers compared with traditional RAG and long-context methods.

items.title: PolitNuggets: Benchmarking Agentic Discovery of Long-Tail Political Facts
items.title_zh: PolitNuggets：评测智能体对长尾政治事实的发现能力
items.summary: PolitNuggets is a multilingual benchmark for agentic information synthesis built from political biographies of 400 global elites covering more than 10,000 facts. It introduces FactNet, an evidence-conditional protocol that scores discovery, fine-grained accuracy and efficiency, and finds current systems often struggle with fine-grained details.

items.title: Is One Score Enough? Rethinking the Evaluation of Sequentially Evolving LLM Memory
items.title_zh: 一个分数就够了吗？重新思考顺序演化 LLM 记忆的评测
items.summary: SeqMem-Eval is a diagnostic framework for sequentially evolving LLM memory that measures online utility, hold-out generalization, backward transfer and forgetting rather than only final or cumulative accuracy. Experiments show that higher final accuracy does not necessarily imply better memory quality, with many methods suffering substantial forgetting or negative transfer.

items.title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: 检索很便宜，给我看代码：面向 RAG 的可执行多跳推理
items.summary: UIUC's PyRAG reformulates multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation as synthesizing and executing Python programs over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states and enabling compiler-grounded self-repair without extra training. It outperforms strong baselines on five QA benchmarks.

items.title: MemEye: A Visual-Centric Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Agent Memory
items.title_zh: MemEye：以视觉为中心的多模态智能体记忆评测框架
items.summary: MemEye is an evaluation framework that measures multimodal agent memory by visual-evidence granularity and retrieval complexity across eight life-scenario tasks. Testing 13 memory methods on four vision-language backbones found that current architectures still lose fine visual detail.

items.title: Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 面向可靠多模态强化学习的排序感知校准
items.summary: Ranking-Aware Calibration is a training-time framework that supervises confidence using two comparison signals already produced by group-based reinforcement learning, so better rollouts receive higher confidence and confidence attenuates as visual evidence degrades. On Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL-3.5 across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks it reduces calibration error under corrupted inputs while improving accuracy in most settings.

items.title: RAG-based EEG-to-Text Translation Using Deep Learning and LLMs
items.title_zh: 基于 RAG 的脑电到文本翻译：结合深度学习与大语言模型
items.summary: The pipeline aligns EEG encoders with sentence embeddings, retrieves candidate sentences from a vector store and has an LLM refine them into text. Across nine subjects on the ZuCo dataset it beat a random baseline with a mean cosine similarity of 0.181 versus 0.139, a 30.45% relative improvement.

items.title: Asymptote-Labs/agent-beacon
items.title_zh: agent-beacon：跨框架、可自我进化的 AI 智能体记忆层
items.summary: agent-beacon describes itself as a cross-harness, self-improving memory layer for AI agents. The Go repository had 2,812 stars and covers topics including agent harnesses, agent security, browser extensions and Claude Code.

items.title: May 12, 2026 Product LiteParse Server: Self-Hostable Document Parsing Read
items.title_zh: LiteParse Server：可自托管的文档解析服务
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced LiteParse Server, a self-hostable document parsing service.

items.title: google-deepmind/science-skills
items.title_zh: google-deepmind/science-skills：加速智能体化科研工作流
items.summary: Google DeepMind released science skills that ground agentic scientific workflows in AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and more than 30 other databases and tools, aiming for better grounding and higher token efficiency. The repository had 3,332 GitHub stars.

items.title: simonlin1212/TradingAgents-astock
items.title_zh: simonlin1212/TradingAgents-astock：面向 A 股的多智能体投研框架
items.summary: TradingAgents-astock is a Python multi-agent investment-research framework rebuilt for Chinese A-share data sources such as dragon-tiger lists and share lock-up expiries. Seven AI analysts debate bull and bear cases before a risk assessment; the repository had 3,791 stars and 951 forks.

items.title: DenisSergeevitch/agents-best-practices
items.title_zh: agents-best-practices：面向 Codex 与 Claude Code 的中立 Agent Skill
items.summary: The agents-best-practices repository offers a provider-neutral Agent Skill for Codex, Claude Code and agentic harness design. It had 2,395 stars and 216 forks and appeared on GitHub Trending on May 15.

items.title: RISE-X-Lab/OpenCollab
items.title_zh: OpenCollab：面向研究的高性能多智能体协作编码框架
items.summary: OpenCollab is a research-friendly, high-performance Python framework for multi-agent collaborative coding, aimed at experiments with teams of agents writing software. The repository had 730 stars and 112 forks.

items.title: datawhalechina/Agent-Learning-Hub
items.title_zh: datawhalechina/Agent-Learning-Hub：AI Agent 学习路线与资料集
items.summary: Datawhale China's Agent-Learning-Hub collects AI agent learning roadmaps and study materials in a Chinese-language HTML project. It had 9,006 GitHub stars and 898 forks when it appeared on GitHub Trending.

items.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.5：具备行动能力的前沿智能
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3.5, billed as frontier intelligence with action and built to help users execute complex, agentic workflows.

items.title: Show HN: adamsreview – better multi-agent PR reviews for Claude Code
items.title_zh: Show HN：adamsreview——为 Claude Code 提供更强的多智能体 PR 审查
items.summary: A developer released adamsreview, a Claude Code plugin with six slash commands that runs multi-stage pull-request review using parallel sub-agents, JSON-persisted state, validation passes and an optional Codex ensemble review. The post drew 85 points and 53 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Co-Scientist: A multi-agent AI partner to accelerate research
items.title_zh: Co-Scientist：加速科研的多智能体 AI 伙伴
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Co-Scientist, a collaborative AI partner built with Gemini that is designed to help researchers accelerate scientific breakthroughs.

items.title: Uniting biological toolkits for a new approach to ALS
items.title_zh: 联合生物工具包探索 ALS 新疗法
items.summary: Google DeepMind says its Co-Scientist system is being used to unite Boston Children's Hospital and MIT labs in exploring new RNA-based treatments for ALS.

items.title: Gemini for Science: AI experiments and tools for a new era of discovery
items.title_zh: Gemini for Science：面向发现新时代的 AI 实验与工具
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini for Science, a collection of science tools and experiments intended to expand the scale and precision of scientific exploration; the announcement provides no further technical detail.

items.title: Synthesizing the Expert: A Validated Multimodal Dataset for Trustworthy AI-Assisted Swimming Coaching
items.title_zh: 合成专家：面向可信 AI 辅助游泳训练的多模态数据集
items.summary: The authors build a multimodal knowledge base spanning physiological data, literature, kinematic sensor data and unstructured expertise, then use a multi-agent LLM architecture to synthesize 1,864 validated question-context-answer triplets for swimming coaching. The dataset is proposed as a benchmark for trustworthy retrieval-augmented AI in aquatics.

items.title: Databricks brings GPT-5.5 to enterprise agent workflows
items.title_zh: Databricks 将 GPT-5.5 引入企业智能体工作流
items.summary: OpenAI says Databricks is using GPT-5.5 for enterprise agent workflows, after the model set a new state of the art on the OfficeQA Pro benchmark.

items.title: MADP: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Sustainable Document Processing with Human-in-the-Loop
items.title_zh: MADP：带人在回路的多智能体可持续文档处理流水线
items.summary: MADP combines deep-learning classification and parsing with LLM extraction across five specialized agents and a human-in-the-loop validator, plus a Prompt Fine Tuning with Feedback Inheritance approach. A production deployment on 955 documents reports a 97.0% full-pipeline automation rate, and the authors estimate a potential reduction of approximately 70% in full-time-equivalent effort for a 100,000-invoice-per-year scenario.
